🌟 Open-Source-Face-Recognition-SDK | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Integrating robust and privacy-preserving face recognition capabilities into applications on Windows and Linux systems.
✨ Key Features: • 100% On-Premise processing • High Accuracy deep learning models • Real-Time Processing • Easy Python API integration • Cross-Platform (Windows/Linux)
📖 Summary: The Open Source Face Recognition SDK is a free, Python-based library for Windows and Linux that enables on-premise face detection, recognition, and comparison using deep learning models. It prioritizes data privacy by processing all information locally and offers real-time performance with optional GPU support.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 video-shotcraft | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate cinematic product videos using AI, leveraging Claude Code or Codex and the Remotion framework.
✨ Key Features: • AI agent skill for Claude Code & Codex • Creates cinematic product videos • Uses Remotion for animation and production • Includes 152 shot recipe cards and 209 motion previews
📖 Summary: video-shotcraft is an AI agent skill that transforms Claude Code or Codex into a motion design studio, enabling the creation of cinematic product videos. It uses Remotion to storyboard, animate, and sound-design promotional, marketing, or demo videos with features like real page captures, 2.5D camera moves, and beat-synced cuts.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 text-to-cad | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating the generation and manipulation of CAD and robot description files using natural language commands and AI agents.
✨ Key Features: • Agent skills for CAD, CAE, and CAM • Text-to-CAD model generation • Image-to-CAD model generation • STEP, STL, 3MF export for CAD • URDF and SDF generation for robotics
📖 Summary: The text-to-cad repository provides a Python library of agent skills designed to automate the creation, inspection, and manipulation of CAD, CAE, and CAM artifacts. It enables users to generate and modify CAD models, robot descriptions (URDF, SRDF), and simulation files (SDF) using natural language or image inputs.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 llm-wiki | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To create and manage LLM-compiled knowledge bases for AI agents, facilitating research, project development, and information retrieval.
✨ Key Features: • LLM-compiled knowledge bases • Parallel multi-agent research • Source ingestion and wiki compilation • Querying and artifact generation • Support for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode
📖 Summary: LLM-Wiki compiles and organizes knowledge for AI agents, transforming raw ideas into structured projects. It supports parallel research, source ingestion, and artifact generation, with compatibility for various AI models and Obsidian.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 altersend | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Direct, secure, and unlimited file transfer between personal devices without relying on cloud services.
✨ Key Features: • No accounts required • No cloud storage, direct P2P transfer • End-to-end encrypted • No file size limits • Receive files directly in a browser
📖 Summary: AlterSend is an open-source application designed for direct, peer-to-peer file transfer between devices. It bypasses cloud storage entirely, ensuring end-to-end encryption, no size limits, and no account requirements for a private and instant file-sharing experience across multiple platforms.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 free-coding-models | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable developers to quickly discover, evaluate, and deploy the most performant and stable free coding LLMs for their development workflow.
✨ Key Features: • Find and benchmark 170+ free coding LLM models • Support for 15+ providers • Real-time latency and stability scores • Live uptime and jitter metrics
📖 Summary: free-coding-models is a command-line interface tool that helps developers find, benchmark, and install free coding Large Language Models (LLMs) from various providers. It provides real-time latency, stability scores, and usage data to help users select the best model for their needs and integrate it directly into their coding tools.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
